note: Village of Arnold municipal recreation area half a mile south of town on Hwy 40: 10 acres around a 22-acre lake stocked by Nebraska Game & Parks, mature shade trees. On the village map sites 10, 11 and 13-15 sit along the shore; the $10 primitive sites are the three tent-only ones (7, 8, 12). Open drive-in grassy loop fits a 23-ft rig. RV dump north of the park entrance on the west side of Hwy 40. NGPC only stocks the lake -- not a state rec area despite some directory labels. --Claude
summary: Village pages + Sept 2025 map: FCFS, no reservations confirmed; electric to 50 A at 28 of 31 numbered sites (note said 'a few'), 3 tent-only; showers/restrooms; $25 electric/water, $10 primitive (fees left as recorded 2026-10-15). Note cleaned (hookup share was wrong, FCFS and price redundant). Lakefront supported by the official map; pin ~210 m off in a hayfield.
flags: WATERFRONT (keep lakefront, weak spot): the village map (ARA-Map-9.25.pdf) draws RV sites 10 and 11 on the bank of the main body by the playground, 14 and 15 on the opposite bank by a hydrant, and 13 by the southwest shore, with the park road behind them, not between - five of 28 RV sites. NAIP (summer) hides that shore under canopy, so I could not see the pads or the apron myself; the open pad rows I can see (likely 24-31) are ~150 m from the water. The map is a per-site official map, so lakefront stands on it; a winter image with the pads visible would settle the apron.

PIN: stored 41.41280,-100.19950 is in an open hayfield south-west of the lake, ~210 m from the lake centre and not on any site. Under 250 m; refine to the west loop road by the pad rows (~41.4142,-100.1990) if convenient.

LEAD: the village camping page also lists Hidden Valley Campground 'just a few miles outside of Arnold with primitive and modern camp sites. They offer electricity, water and sewer ... modern bathrooms and showers ... Open early April through late September', reservations via the campground manager, cell (308) 520-4787 / ranch (308) 848-2670 (https://arnoldne.org/nebraska-camping/). Not in the database (private; needs the private gate). The same page lists Arnold Motel & Campsite (five RV hookups at a motel, apartments for longer stays) - probably not a campground under the criteria.

Website and phone OK (308-848-2228, the Village office named on the camping page). https://arnoldne.org/nebraska-camping/ carries the camping terms if a deeper link is wanted. Season not stated by the village.
